issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Zinley
products.tagline: Your Personal AI Representative for calls, email, and tasks
products.summaryZh: 您的个人AI代表，负责接听电话、处理邮件和执行任务。
products.descriptionZh: 大多数AI只存在于聊天界面中。Zinley则随时可被你及你周围的人联系到。它拥有自己的电话号码和电子邮件，能接听电话、处理邮件、预订事务，并在你设定的规则内完成工作。它记住你的人际关系和联系，然后用你的语言向你汇报。不是又一个聊天机器人，而是另一个你，随时出现。
products.description: Most AI waits inside a chat. Zinley is reachable by you and the people around you. With its own phone number and email, it answers calls, handles email, books things, and gets work done within your rules. It remembers your people and relationships, then reports back in your language. Not another chatbot. A second you that shows up.

products.name: Capptivo
products.tagline: Free open-source screen recorder & demo editor
products.summaryZh: 免费开源屏幕录制与演示编辑工具
products.descriptionZh: Capptivo是一款免费、开源的屏幕录制和演示编辑工具，支持macOS、Windows和Linux。本地录制，添加跟随光标的缩放，美化外观，烧录设备端字幕，并导出，无需账户，无需订阅。让你的演示获得应有的关注。
products.description: Capptivo is a free, open-source screen recorder and demo editor for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Record locally, add follow-cursor zooms, polish the look, burn on-device captions, and export, no account, no subscription. Give your demos the spotlight they deserve.

products.name: YourSitee
products.tagline: Make your bio link worth clicking
products.summaryZh: 让你的个人简介链接值得点击。
products.descriptionZh: YourSitee将你分散的线上足迹整合为一个视觉页面，让它像你本人，而非又一串按钮。通过20多个组件构建，用AI导入你的Linktree，并借助内置分析了解用户点击。所有链接，汇聚一处。
products.description: YourSitee turns your scattered online presence into one visual page that feels like you, not another list of buttons. Build with 20+ widgets, import your Linktree with AI, and see what people click with built-in analytics. All your links. One place.

products.name: Lumichats
products.tagline: A Claude Code alternative for people who avoid the terminal
products.summaryZh: 面向不愿使用终端用户的Claude Code替代方案
products.descriptionZh: 7万人在浏览器中使用LumiChats，并一直要求实现浏览器无法做到的一件事：访问他们的文件。因此，我们开发了桌面版。它能在你的电脑上执行命令，编写真实文档，而你只需为实际运行的工作付费。
products.description: 70,000 people use LumiChats in a browser and kept asking for the one thing a browser cannot do: touch their files. So we built the desktop one. It runs commands on your machine, writes real documents, and you pay only for the work you run.

products.name: Zen Whisper
products.tagline: On-device Mac dictation that types into any app
products.summaryZh: 在Mac上运行的本地听写功能，可在任何应用中输入文字。
products.descriptionZh: 按住快捷键，在任何Mac应用中口述，无需将音频发送到云端。Zen Whisper将核心语音识别保留在设备端，支持本地模型、可搜索的转录文本、语音备忘录、媒体转录，以及用于更大模型和翻译的Pro工具。
products.description: Hold a shortcut and dictate into any Mac app without sending audio to the cloud. Zen Whisper keeps core speech recognition on-device, with local models, searchable transcripts, voice memos, media transcription, and Pro tools for larger models and translation.

products.name: UniwebPay Skill
products.tagline: Financial Infra for the AI era
products.summaryZh: 面向AI时代的金融基础设施
products.descriptionZh: 发货即收款。UniwebPay Skill 是 AI 时代的金融基础设施，帮助开发者将 AI 产品转化为业务。生成支付链接，接受全球支付方式，无需常规支付设置、商户入驻或基础设施开销，即可开始收款。
products.description: Accept payments the moment you ship. UniwebPay Skill is the financial infrastructure for the AI era, helping builders turn AI products into businesses. Generate payment links, accept global payment methods, and start getting paid without the usual payment setup, merchant onboarding, or infrastructure overhead.

products.name: Termexo
products.tagline: A local Windows workbench for Claude Code and Codex
products.summaryZh: 适用于Claude Code和Codex的本地Windows工作台
products.descriptionZh: Termexo将Claude Code和Codex整合到一个可恢复的Windows工作区中。在自定义网格中排列真实PTY终端，搜索并恢复原生会话，当代理需要审批时收到通知，无需重建环境变量即可切换兼容Claude的模型配置。本地优先，无需Termexo账户。
products.description: Termexo brings Claude Code and Codex into one recoverable Windows workspace. Arrange real PTY terminals in custom grids, search and resume native sessions, get notified when an agent needs approval, and switch Claude-compatible model profiles without rebuilding environment variables. Local-first, no Termexo account required.

products.name: Bolcho AI
products.tagline: Build Voice AI agents that actually speak India
products.summaryZh: 构建真正会说印度语言的语音AI代理
products.descriptionZh: Bolcho AI是一个AI语音平台，帮助企业构建、部署并扩展多语言AI电话和网页代理。与通用型Voice AI平台不同，Bolcho专为印度市场打造——支持本地语言、超低延迟、电话系统集成，并允许用户自带LLM、STT和TTS提供商。从销售、客服到预约和客户互动，几分钟内即可上线生产级语音代理。
products.description: Bolcho AI is an AI voice platform that helps businesses build, deploy and scale multilingual AI phone and web agents. Unlike generic Voice AI platforms, Bolcho is built for India—with native language support, ultra-low latency, telephony integrations, and the flexibility to bring your own LLMs, STT, and TTS providers. From sales and support to appointment booking and customer engagement, launch production-ready voice agents in minutes.

products.name: TimeOS 2.0
products.tagline: Work your tasks. Bill your clients with confidence.
products.summaryZh: 高效完成任务，自信地向客户开具账单。
products.descriptionZh: 距首个TimeOS发布已两年！是时候迎来2.0更新了！TimeOS 2.0与配套的Invoicing应用实现闭环。点击Load，然后生成PDF，你的会话即变为明细项！如需可自定义发票，下载PDF并发送给客户。
products.description: Two years since the first TimeOS! And It's time for 2.0 update! TimeOS 2.0 closes the loop with companion Invoicing app. Hit Load, then Generate PDF and your sessions become line items! Customize the invoice if needed, download the PDF and sent to the client.

products.name: FreqWave EQ
products.tagline: Customize your web audio with a real-time EQ
products.summaryZh: 实时均衡器，定制你的网络音频体验。
products.descriptionZh: 8段网页音频均衡器——修复浑浊的播客、刺耳的流媒体和低沉的对话。配备EQ模式与DSP压缩。
products.description: 8-band Web Audio Equalizer - fixing muddy podcasts, harsh streams and quiet dialogue. Featuring EQ modes and DSP Compression.

products.name: PraiseEngine
products.tagline: Turn customer conversations into SEO-ready social proof.
products.summaryZh: 将客户对话转化为符合SEO要求的社交证明。
products.descriptionZh: PraiseEngine是一个AI原生的评价平台，将空白文本框转化为无摩擦的访谈体验。通过针对您业务定制的3问题自适应AI访谈，它直接从客户的话语中起草有根据、准确的推荐语。团队在发布前审核每一条内容，可通过一行网站嵌入或带JSON-LD schema的可索引SEO评价档案进行发布。专为需要自动化信任生成且无自动发布风险的个人创业者、SaaS成长型公司和代理机构打造。
products.description: PraiseEngine is an AI-native review platform that turns blank textareas into frictionless interviews. Using a 3-question adaptive AI Interview tailored to your business, it drafts grounded, accurate testimonials directly from your customer’s words. Teams moderate every entry before publishing via one-line website embeds or indexable SEO review profiles with JSON-LD schema. Built for solopreneurs, SaaS scaleups, and agencies needing automated trust generation without auto-publish risk.

products.name: Apoointly
products.tagline: Your 24/7 AI Front Desk Built for Healthcare Practice
products.summaryZh: 您的全天候AI前台，专为医疗机构打造
products.descriptionZh: Apoointly是一款为医疗机构打造的AI前台。它接听患者来电、安排预约、管理随访，帮助诊所减少漏接电话，同时不增加额外行政负担。专为繁忙的医疗团队设计，Apoointly全天候运作，改善患者沟通并简化前台运营。
products.description: Apoointly is an AI front desk built for healthcare practices. It answers patient calls, schedules appointments, manages follow-ups, and helps clinics reduce missed calls without adding more administrative work. Designed for busy healthcare teams, Apoointly works around the clock to improve patient communication and streamline front desk operations.

products.name: TextMyPill
products.tagline: WhatsApp medicine reminders. No app needed. 🦦
products.summaryZh: WhatsApp用药提醒。无需安装应用。🦦
products.descriptionZh: 在一个仪表板上，为自己或全家人设置用药提醒——无论身处世界何处。Pillo会自动通过WhatsApp发送提醒。拍下处方，AI读取，完成。追踪谁服用了什么。无需安装应用。免费试用7天。
products.description: Set medicine reminders for yourself or your entire family from one dashboard — anywhere in the world. Pillo delivers reminders on WhatsApp automatically. Snap a prescription, AI reads it, done. Track who took what. No app needed. Free 7-day trial.

products.name: GrowthRail
products.tagline: Add referrals in an afternoon, free to start.
products.summaryZh: 一个下午即可添加推荐功能，免费开始使用。
products.descriptionZh: GrowthRail是一个面向开发者的推荐平台，用于启动和管理原生推荐计划。通过即插即用的SDK和推荐API，可集成到SaaS、网页及移动应用中。
products.description: GrowthRail is a developer-first referral platform to launch and manage native referral programs. Integrates via drop-in SDKs & referral APIs for SaaS, web, and mobile apps.

products.name: InvoProof
products.tagline: Invoice-verified reviews for freelancers
products.summaryZh: 自由职业者的发票核验评价
products.descriptionZh: InvoProof将每一张已付款发票转化为你公开作品集中的可验证案例。发送专业发票，收到付款后，客户评价——与真实付款可验证关联——自动成为你主页上的证明。无需追讨推荐信，没有虚假评价，作品集页面不再空白。最多免费支持3个项目。
products.description: InvoProof turns every paid invoice into a verified case study on your public portfolio. Send a professional invoice, get paid, and the client's review — provably tied to that real payment — becomes proof on your profile automatically. No chasing testimonials, no fake reviews, no blank portfolio pages. Free for up to 3 projects.

products.name: MergeImage
products.tagline: Merge up to 30 images locally, privately, and free
products.summaryZh: 本地合并最多30张图片，私密且免费。
products.descriptionZh: MergeImage可在浏览器中合并最多30个PNG、JPEG或WebP文件。支持水平、垂直、网格排列，或使用保守的智能拼接处理滚动截图。可调整顺序、旋转、翻转、缩放、间距和背景，预览后导出为PNG、JPEG或WebP。无需账户、无水印、无付费API，也不会上传图片至处理服务器。
products.description: MergeImage combines up to 30 PNG, JPEG, or WebP files entirely in your browser. Arrange images horizontally, vertically, in a grid, or use conservative smart stitching for scrolling screenshots. Reorder, rotate, flip, resize, adjust spacing and background, preview, then export PNG, JPEG, or WebP. No account, watermark, paid API, or image upload to a processing server.

products.name: Klyve
products.tagline: Turn a prompt into a motion graphics ad for your SaaS
products.summaryZh: 将提示词转化为你的SaaS动态图形广告
products.descriptionZh: Klyve的AI导演为你的SaaS定制一支符合品牌调性的动态图形广告，融入你的真实色彩、界面截图和旁白。无需编码，无需剪辑，无需时间线。只需一个提示词，即可获得一支成品广告。
products.description: Klyve's AI director composes a bespoke, on-brand motion graphics ad for your SaaS, pulling in your real colors, screens, and narration. No code, no editors, no timeline. Just a prompt and a finished ad.

products.name: Mitra
products.tagline: An animated cute desktop companion that helps you focus
products.summaryZh: 一个可爱的动画桌面伙伴，帮助你保持专注。
products.descriptionZh: 可爱到让人喜欢，聪明到能帮忙。认识一下 Mitra——一个有个性的迷你桌面伙伴。她住在你的桌面上，对你的工作流程做出反应，提醒你健康休息，在你专注时安静地不打扰。凭借流畅的物理效果、零追踪和本地优先的设计，Mitra 轻量、可定制、隐私优先，且完全开源。✨ 交互物理效果 • 💻 智能反应 • ⏰ 健康提醒 • 🔒 隐私优先 • 🌍 开源
products.description: Cute enough to love. Smart enough to help. Meet Mitra—your tiny desktop companion with personality. She lives on your desktop, reacts to your workflow, reminds you to take healthy breaks, and quietly stays out of the way when you're focused. With smooth physics, zero tracking, and a local-first design, Mitra is lightweight, customizable, privacy-first, and fully open source. ✨ Interactive physics • 💻 Smart reactions • ⏰ Wellness reminders • 🔒 Privacy-first • 🌍 Open source

products.name: Finamie
products.tagline: Speak your expenses and get instant spending insights
products.summaryZh: 说出你的开支，即刻获得消费洞察。
products.descriptionZh: Finamie将你的语音转化为详细的财务洞察，全程自动。免提记录开支，追踪消费，以前所未有的方式理解你的财务状况。
products.description: Finamie turns your voice into detailed financial insights, automatically. Log expenses hands-free, track your spending, and understand your money like never before.

products.name: KlientFlow — Never forget client context
products.tagline: Never lose another client because you forgot to follow up.
products.summaryZh: 再也不会因为忘记跟进而失去客户。
products.descriptionZh: 每个CRM都在记录已经发生的事。KlientFlow告诉你今天谁在等你回复。专为每月在LinkedIn、Instagram和邮件中发送20-50条私信的自由职业者及独立创始人打造。它保留每段对话的上下文，安排跟进计划，并在该跟进时把消息递到你手上。消息仍由你亲自发送。
products.description: Every CRM records what already happened. KlientFlow tells you who's waiting on you today. Built for freelancers and solo founders sending 20-50 DMs a month across LinkedIn, Instagram and email. It keeps the context of each conversation, schedules the follow-ups, and hands you the message when it's due. You still send it yourself.
